Overview

Killer (Godspeed) is a MythicalMythical unit. He is only obtainable by evolving Killer (Whirlwind).

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.

Passive Ability: Stun

Killer (Godspeed)'s lightning attacks are able to stun enemies for a few seconds. Unlike other stunners like Packy (Maniac) or Jolyna (Determination), his stun is available, even at Upgrade 0, making him useful for emergency stuns for other units to have another chance of finishing them off.

Selling

Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.
